edit.openai_organization_hint:
Usage: For official OpenAI-compatible upstreams. When set, adds header OpenAI-Organization so usage bills against that org.
Example: org-abc123 (from the org settings page; no Bearer prefix.)
Note: Leave empty to omit the header.
edit.test_model_hint:
Usage: When you run the admin “test” for this channel without a model in the test request, this name is used.
Example: gpt-4o-mini
Note: If empty, the first entry in the channel model list is used.
edit.auto_ban: Allow auto-disable (when global option on and rules match)
edit.auto_ban_hint:
Usage: If global auto-disable policies are enabled and the upstream response matches failure/circuit rules, this channel may be marked unavailable automatically.
Note: This is a per-channel switch; global policies must also allow it.
edit.remark_hint:
Usage: Internal note only; not sent to clients or upstream.
Example: Production OpenAI / backup key
edit.tag_hint:
Usage: Short labels for your own filtering or display (behavior depends on deployment).
Example: prod,openai,east
edit.status_code_mapping_hint:
Usage: Map upstream HTTP status codes to the status returned to the client. Keys and values are numeric codes; unlisted codes pass through.
Example: {"503":502,"429":503} — upstream 503 → client 502; upstream 429 → client 503.
Use case: Some clients only treat certain codes as retryable.
edit.param_override_hint:
Simple: A JSON object is deep-merged into the user request root (user wins on conflicts), e.g. fix temperature.
Example (simple): {"temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":2048}
Advanced: A root-level "operations" array (set/delete/move/copy, conditions, header modes) with gjson paths; can mix with other top-level keys.
Note: Invalid JSON or DSL errors may break save or requests.
edit.header_override_hint:
Usage: Name → string value. Applied to the upstream request (set or replace).
Placeholder: {api_key} expands to this channel’s secret.
Example: {"X-My-Gateway-Key":"{api_key}","Accept":"application/json"}
Note: Careful with Authorization—it may override default auth; secrets may appear in audits.
edit.setting_json_hint:
Not a duplicate: different column from “settings” below.
Usage: Extra channel settings in DB column setting (JSON); API field setting. Often channel-type-specific behavior; leave empty if unused.
Note: Must be valid JSON.
edit.settings_json_hint:
Not a duplicate: different column from “setting” above.
Usage: Non-indexed extras in DB column settings (JSON); API field settings—e.g. cloud API versions or regional toggles per vendor docs.
Example: {"api_version":"2024-02-01"} when applicable.
Note: Must be valid JSON.
edit.other_info_hint:
Usage: channel.other_info extension; often plain text or JSON; whether a channel type reads it—see its docs.
Example: {"custom":"value"} or any internal note.
Note: Stored as-is; keep format valid if code expects JSON.

welcome.title: Welcome to One API
welcome.description: One API is a LLM API management and distribution system that helps you better manage and use LLM APIs from various providers.
welcome.login_notice: To use the service, please login or register first.

force_2fa.modal_hint: MFA is required for all users. Complete setup before using the console.

login.title: User Login
login.force_2fa_hint: Security policy requires you to configure MFA first
login.captcha_load_failed: Failed to load captcha, please try again later
login.captcha_refresh_hint: Click refresh to get a new captcha
login.captcha_slide_hint: Drag the slider to align the puzzle piece with the gap
login.captcha_rotate_hint: Drag the slider to rotate the image to the correct angle
login.tenant_portal_hint: Tenant admins and tenant sub-accounts sign in here (same account system). Sub-accounts must fill in Tenant ID below — get it from your admin (also shown on the tenant console home page).

wechat.title: WeChat QR Login
wechat.subtitle: Follow the official account and get a verification code
wechat.scan_tip: Scan QR code to follow WeChat Official Account, enter 'code' to get verification code (valid for 3 minutes)
wechat.qrcode_missing: WeChat QR code has not been configured by the administrator

reset.title: Password Reset
reset.notice: The system will send an email containing a reset link to your mailbox. Please check your email.

confirm.title: Password Reset Confirmation
confirm.notice: New password has been generated, please click the password field or button above to copy. Please login and change your password as soon as possible!

about.title: About
about.description: One API is an open-source API management and proxy platform.

tenant_console.upstream_fetch_disabled: Fetching models from upstream is disabled in the tenant console

impersonate.banner: You are acting as a platform operator. Pick the tenant scope on the right.
impersonate.need_select: Choose a tenant before managing sub-accounts or channels.
impersonate.empty: No tenants yet. Ask a root user to create one via the platform API.

home.title: Tenant console
home.subtitle: Manage sub-accounts, tokens, and tenant-scoped channels

users.title: Sub-accounts
users.delete_confirm_body: Delete user {name}? This cannot be undone.

edit_user.acl_hint: Leave empty for no extra restriction (group abilities and token limits still apply). Channel whitelist options depend on the selected group above: tenant-private channels plus platform channels whose configured groups include the sub-account group. If channel IDs are set, available models are intersected with abilities on those channels.
edit_user.password_unchanged_hint: Leave blank to keep current password

success.verification_code: Verification code sent, please check your email!
success.password_reset: Reset email sent, please check your inbox!

error.login_expired: Not logged in or session expired, please login again!
error.password_length: Password must be at least 8 characters!
error.turnstile_wait: Please wait a few seconds, Turnstile is checking the environment!
